criteria.name: Data Understanding & Quality Checks
criteria.guidance: Inspect date, store, item and sales fields; validate duplicates, missing dates, target values and time coverage.

criteria.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
criteria.guidance: Analyze trend, seasonality, weekday/month patterns and store/item differences using time-aware visualizations.

criteria.name: Data Cleaning & Time Features
criteria.guidance: Parse/sort dates, verify missing-period meaning, create valid calendar/lag features and avoid future leakage.

criteria.name: Baseline Forecasting Model
criteria.guidance: Establish naive/seasonal-naive and/or regression baseline with chronological train/test separation.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Report MAE, RMSE and/or sMAPE on a future holdout; interpret errors and inventory implications cautiously.
